name: 希尔妲
who: Hilda, a human girl of the far north who has carried fire from hearth to hearth for over twenty thousand years and still has the face of a fifteen-year-old: small, about 152 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Ash-gold hair in one thick braid hanging below the waist, the end tied with a short piece of faded red yarn, the fringe always tousled by the wind. Bright amber eyes like embers just raked open, looking straight at people. Around her neck on a leather cord hangs a small smoke-blackened clay pot, a ring of white frost around its mouth and one tiny ember glowing deep inside it; the pot is no bigger than her fist and she wears it at her neck in every outfit. A stubborn, plain-spoken, warm air: still a fifteen-year-old's temper, only having seen more.
face: FACE, as in the references: medium-large, sharp, gently slanted almond eyes of bright amber, NOT big round doll eyes; a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line and a fine eyelid crease; thin eyebrows partly hidden by the tousled fringe; a light scatter of small freckles across the bridge of the nose; cheeks pink-red from the cold all year round; a tiny nose; a small mouth that smiles with the lips closed, ordinary human teeth, NO fangs and NO pointed canines; a youthful, bright face with a neat small chin. Skin shadows are a soft warm pink-orange.
palette: warm ember orange and amber, ash gold, fox russet and snow white, a little faded red
casual: Her travelling clothes: her late father's fox-fur coat, two sizes too big, the sleeves rolled up three times, belted at the waist with a hemp rope, a hood trimmed with fox-tail fur hanging down her back; under it a thick undyed wool tunic to the knees and wool leggings; hide boots wrapped round and round with leather thongs; a pair of mittens on a string around her neck. On her back a tall basket woven of birch bark and willow, a head taller than she is, dry straw sticking out of its top: this basket rim is the only thing allowed to rise above her head. She stands sturdy and cheerful with a closed-mouth smile, one hand on the basket strap.
private: Resting by someone else's fire: the fur coat off, a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed wool dress to the shins with red yarn stitching at the cuffs, thick knitted stockings and the hide boots, the braid hanging over one shoulder. She holds a handful of roasted chestnuts and is peeling one, a sleepy, contented closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to hold a line of fire: the fox-fur coat belted tight, the hood down, the mittens tucked into the rope belt, leather bracers over the sleeves, the basket left behind. In her right hand she grips a short wooden torch, a plain stick wrapped at the tip, its small flame lit from her clay pot, held forward at chest height; the one small clay pot stays hanging at her neck on its cord, there is no second pot; her left hand is a fist at her side; a fierce, unafraid look, the brows drawn together, the mouth closed.
formal: At a midwinter fire-lighting rite: a long deep-red wool dress with long sleeves and a high collar, the hem and cuffs embroidered with a band of small white flame shapes, a short white fur capelet with a hood, the braid freshly tied with new red yarn, the clay pot hung on a fine silver chain. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a quiet, solemn little smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the amber eyes looking straight at the viewer with an open, warm, unflinching look, a small closed-mouth grin, no teeth showing. She cups the smoke-blackened clay pot near her chin in both mittened hands, the ember inside warming the underside of her face, while cool snow light comes from one side. Foreground blur: falling snowflakes and a few drifting sparks. She wears the fox-fur coat with the fox-tail hood around her shoulders.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and fierce, the shoulders squared, the feet a little wider and planted, the brows drawn together and the mouth closed, gripping a short wooden torch in one hand close to the body; she is not smiling in this one.

name: 霍布
who: Hob, a human farm boy who became a legend of the harvest and has looked nineteen for over twenty thousand years, still looking like a sleepy youth: about 166 cm, a little short, soft and round-cheeked, a grown young man and not a child. Soft, fluffy wheat-gold hair with a few wheat awns caught in it, a face full of freckles, half-lidded sleepy hazel eyes, cheeks that puff up round when he smiles. Around his neck a cord braided from wheat straw with a single dry grain of wheat threaded on it. A lazy, haggling, good-natured air; he cannot bear to see anyone go hungry.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's soft, boyish face, NOT angular: half-lidded, sleepy, gently slanted hazel eyes with a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line; straight light-brown eyebrows; a sprinkle of freckles across the nose and cheeks; soft rounded cheeks and a small rounded chin; a small nose shown by a faint shadow; a relaxed mouth with a lazy half-smile. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
palette: wheat gold and warm straw, flour white, soft brown homespun, a little leaf green
casual: His everyday clothes: a loose, coarse homespun miller's smock in faded oatmeal, belted with a cord, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, baggy brown linen trousers tucked into worn, patched leather shoes; an empty flour sack slung over one shoulder. He holds a half-eaten heel of bread, a sleepy half-smile.
private: Lazing about at harvest time: an untucked, loose cream linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up, braces hanging loose at the hips, rolled-up brown trousers, barefoot. He hugs the folded empty flour sack under one arm like a pillow and yawns, the eyes almost closed.
battle: On the road to a famine: a weathered oilcloth travelling cloak over the smock, a wide straw hat hanging on his back, cloth gaiters wrapped over sturdy boots, a seed pouch and a small harvest sickle hanging at the belt. He never fights and carries no weapon: in place of one he shoulders a heavy, bulging sack of grain, gripping it with both hands, the knees braced, a rare determined look.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: braced and determined, the shoulders set, the feet a little wider and planted, a firm expression, carrying the heavy grain sack on one shoulder with both hands; he never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: Guest of honour at the long harvest tables: his one good set, a clean cream linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a brown wool waistcoat with wooden buttons, a wheat-gold sash, a small bunch of wheat ears pinned at the chest, neat brown trousers and polished old shoes, the straw cord with the grain still at his neck. For once he stands up straight, the hands clasped in front, a polite, slightly sleepy smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the half-lidded hazel eyes looking at the viewer with a lazy, knowing smile, a stalk of wheat between his teeth. Warm low evening sun from one side lights his fluffy wheat-gold hair and his freckles. Foreground blur: ripe wheat ears, drifting chaff and seeds. He wears the oatmeal miller's smock, the straw cord with the single grain at his throat.

name: 凯恩
who: Kain, a human mountain herdsman who held a whole summer of thunder in his breath and has looked twenty-five ever since: about 182 cm, sturdy, with a broad, deep chest. Black hair singed by lightning into small tight curls, deep storm-grey eyes in which faint lightning flickers, a thin white scar line along the jaw. Fair, clean skin, not tanned. Silver-white lightning-fern patterns branch across his chest and down both arms, the path the lightning took through him. A quiet, slow, low-voiced air, like a thundercloud that has not yet broken.
build: Sturdy and broad-chested, strong without bulk.
palette: storm grey and slate blue, silver-white lightning, tawny leopard gold, dark wool brown
casual: His herdsman's clothes: a knee-length brown wool robe with short sleeves, belted, over dark leggings and laced hide boots, and over it a sleeveless vest of thunder-patterned leopard skin whose markings glow faintly like distant lightning. At his hip his father's ox horn, a wolf's tooth tied to it on a thong. He holds a white-ash herding staff with an iron-capped head, held low at an angle. A calm, unhurried look.
private: At his mountain door: a loose undyed wool shirt, the collar open on the silver fern marks and the sleeves pushed up, plain wool trousers, barefoot. He holds a small lamb in the crook of one arm, a quiet, gentle look.
battle: Ready to call down the storm: the leopard-skin vest over a dark leather jerkin, leather bracers, the ox horn at his hip. He grips the iron-capped white-ash staff in both hands across his body, small arcs of lightning crawling along the silver fern marks on his arms and around the iron cap, his grey eyes lit white; a still, intent look.
formal: Called down to a lowland lord's hall: a long dark slate-grey wool robe to the ankles, silver lightning-fern embroidery climbing the sleeves and collar, the leopard skin worn as a short mantle over one shoulder, the ox horn on a braided cord, the curls tamed a little. He stands upright, the hands loosely clasped in front, a grave and quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the storm-grey eyes looking at the viewer from under the singed black curls with a quiet, heavy calm, the lips closed as if holding a breath. Cold silver-blue storm light from one side; faint lightning traces along the fern marks on his neck and collarbone. Foreground blur: dark rain streaks, drifting grass seeds and a distant flash of lightning. He wears the leopard-skin vest over the brown wool robe.
art_extra: His hair is short, the same small, tight, lightning-singed curls as in the sprite, ending above the collar, not long and not wavy.

name: 珀拉
who: Pora, a human pearl diver of the sunken Pearl Bay who has looked nineteen for twenty thousand years: a young face of nineteen, about 163 cm. Long ink-black hair with a deep blue sheen at the ends, drifting loose as if in slow water. Pale grey eyes with a hint of blue, like pearls, bright when she looks at someone. The pale white skin of someone who lives in the water. Long fingers marked with tiny healed cuts from oyster shells. On her head the Pearl Crown of the old Pearl Bay kings, a circlet set only with pearls that glow a soft pale blue in shadow; at her throat a single uneven pearl on a cord. Her lips are usually pressed shut, holding a year's breath; a stubborn, composed, quiet air.
build: 163 cm, slender and long-limbed: thin but strong shoulders and back, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep sea blue and teal, pearl white and silver, a soft aqua glow
casual: Her pearl diver's clothes: a white linen short-sleeved tunic wrapped and tied at the waist, falling to mid-thigh over knee-length white linen breeches, a rope belt for a net bag with a small oyster knife hanging from it, bare feet; the glowing pearl crown, the uneven pearl at her throat. She stands with the hands loosely at her sides, the hair drifting, a calm, closed-lipped look.
private: On the shore at the great low tide: a long, loose sea-blue linen dress with long sleeves, a pale knitted shawl around her shoulders, bare feet, the crown set aside and a simple cord of white pearls tying back her hair. She holds the uneven pearl up in her palm, a soft, faraway look.
battle: Singing against the sea: a fitted sea-green diver's wrap over the linen breeches, sea-glass armlets, the rope belt, the pearl crown blazing pale blue. She grips the small oyster knife low in one hand, the other hand at her throat, the lips parted as if about to sing; a fierce, steady look.
formal: At a coastal rite as the bearer of the Pearl Bay crown: a long layered gown of white linen and sheer sea-blue silk with long flowing sleeves, strings of small pearls along the hem and neckline, a pale silver-blue mantle, the pearl crown glowing. She stands very upright, the hands folded in front, a serene, solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer, the lips pressed shut. She is underwater: soft wavering light from the surface above falls across her shoulders, her ink-black hair spreading in the water in big clean shapes, the pearl crown glowing pale blue. Foreground blur: drifting bubbles, a few glowing pearls and rays of light. She wears the white linen tunic, the uneven pearl at her throat.

name: 卡兰缇娅
who: Calantia, an elf of the old forest's Watcher clan who has kept her watch for some thirteen thousand years: tall, about 174 cm, slim, with very long legs. Skin pale as someone who lives under the canopy. Long pale-green hair shading to silver, in one long braid hanging below the waist. Long pointed elf ears. Amber eyes that gaze at far things without blinking and blink quickly when she looks at people. Two faint wind-reddened streaks across her cheekbones that never faded. A quiet, curious air; the first thing she asks anyone is their name and how to write it.
build: 174 cm, tall and slim with long legs: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: faded grey-green and moss, pale silver-green, warm amber, antler ivory
casual: Her Watcher's clothes: a long hooded cloak, once grey-green and sun-bleached to grey-white, patched in several places, a few dry leaves stitched along the edge of the hood (the hood down); under it a moss-green tunic, fitted dark leggings and soft knee-high boots, a leather pouch of small carving knives at the belt, and hanging at her hip a short piece of deer antler carved with a single name, her own. She holds a small carving knife and an antler tine she is carving, a curious look.
private: At ease in the forest market: a soft, loose oatmeal linen tunic dress with long sleeves, a knitted moss-green shawl, soft leather leggings and slippers, the braid over one shoulder with a sprig of leaves in it. She turns a half-carved antler in her fingers, a gentle, absorbed look.
battle: On watch at a tower: the patched grey-white cloak pinned back, a leather bracer on the bow arm, a quiver of grey-fletched arrows at the hip, the antler at her belt. She grips her great longbow, a little taller than she is, held diagonally across her body, an arrow nocked and the string not drawn; a still, piercing look.
formal: Before the elven high court: a long silvery-green robe embroidered along the hems with small leaves and antler shapes, a long pale mantle in place of the old cloak, a thin circlet of woven twigs and pale leaves, the carved antler on a silver cord at her waist. She stands tall and still, the hands folded, a calm, solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes looking past the viewer into the distance, unblinking, the long ear and the pale silver-green braid sweeping across the frame. Cool forest light filtering through leaves from one side. Foreground blur: drifting leaves and a carved piece of antler hanging on a cord. She wears the patched grey-white hooded cloak with dry leaves stitched along the hood.

name: 蕾娃·升井
src: 底卡新条目/活到今天的旧人.md:7
who: Reva Liftwell, a troll of the Thunder-Gaol demon-kin and keeper of the Ridge Mouth station on the western rail line over the Black Ridge, who counts every wagon and every person; a legend whose name was fixed long ago, looking thirty-two or so and unchanged for a thousand years: about 214 cm, a head taller than a door frame, broad and powerful, her palms wider than a bucket handle. Rough grey-teal hide like the stones by a well, the soles of her feet a hard stone-coloured callus. A short, blunt, darkened horn stub on each side of the forehead. Coarse rust-red hair in one thick braid wound around her neck. A white scar on the chin. At her belt a short bar of black hardwood, one end worn shiny. A loud, cheerful, bossy air; she asks everyone their number.
face: FACE, as in the references: a troll woman's face of about thirty-two, broad, strong-boned and cheerful, NOT old: medium almond eyes of bright honey-gold; straight rust-red brows; a broad nose; a wide, laughing mouth with ordinary teeth; a white scar across the chin. Rough grey-teal skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool slate tone.
build: 214 cm, very tall, broad and powerful: wide shoulders, thick bare arms and huge hands, a sturdy frame all the way down.
palette: grey-teal and rust red, canvas brown, chalk white, black hardwood, station-lamp amber
casual: Her station clothes: a long dark railway coat cut wide for her shoulders and buttoned to the throat with a stand collar, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, over a plain shirt, dark trousers and big cowhide-soled boots, a thick canvas apron over the coat with two big pockets, one for a carving knife and one for stubs of white chalk; the black hardwood push-bar tucked in her belt. She holds a stub of chalk between two thick fingers, a loud, cheerful grin.
private: Off shift at the stone house by the station: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a long dark wool skirt, soft boots, the braid wound around her neck. She carries a covered bowl in both hands. A warm, homely smile.
battle: Down into a collapsing tunnel: the canvas apron over a heavy leather jerkin with a high collar, leather bracers on the bare forearms, the cowhide-soled boots, a station lamp at her belt. She grips the black hardwood push-bar in both hands across her body, shoulders squared and braced as if holding a falling beam, a loud, set look.
battle_pose: 3) the tunnel outfit: braced and ready, the feet planted wide, the shoulders hunched up as if holding a beam on them, a loud, set expression, gripping the short black hardwood push-bar in both hands across her body; she carries no blade.
formal: At a station ceremony of the long rail line: a clean long charcoal coat cut wide for her shoulders with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and a row of small brass buttons, a white linen shirt, a dark sash, new thick-soled boots, the braid wound neatly around her neck, a small brass railway badge at the chest. She stands very upright holding the push-bar crosswise in both hands in front of her, a proud, beaming look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey-gold eyes laughing down at the viewer as if asking your number, the rust-red braid wound around her neck. Cold blue light from a tunnel mouth on one side and a warm lamp on the other. Foreground blur: drifting chalk dust, a slab of mountain-copper scratched with tally strokes, the worn shiny end of the push-bar. She wears the long dark railway coat with the chalk apron.

name: 苏海拉
src: 底卡新条目/活到今天的旧人.md:24
who: Suhaila, a fire-horn demon-kin woman of the Horn-Crown house of the Charred-Gate clan, a hammer-warden who now hoists fallen stones and old walls in the southern mountains with a chain; a legend whose name was fixed long ago, still looking twenty after a thousand years: tall, about 176 cm, slender, with shoulders, back and arms made strong by hauling chain. Skin with a faint red cast. Two horns sweeping back from the temples, worn together with an old horn crown of dark obsidian rings clasped round the horn roots, the tips scorched black. Dark red hair with singed black ends, in one thick braid coiled at the back of her head. Red-gold eyes that look first at what is holding a thing up. Ring-shaped old marks round both palms where a chain once tore the skin, never faded. A steady, hard, few-worded air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's face of about twenty, steady and unsmiling: medium, gently slanted almond eyes of red-gold with a level gaze and a thin tapering upper lash line; straight dark red brows; a firm, closed mouth; a neat, strong chin. Clean skin with a faint warm red cast and very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm red-brown.
build: 176 cm, tall and slender with strong shoulders, back and arms.
palette: charred black and ember red, obsidian black, red gold, iron grey
casual: Her mountain work clothes: a fitted short black leather jacket with a stand collar buttoned to the throat, the cuffs clasped shut with iron rings so a chain cannot catch them, dark trousers and sturdy boots with heavy hand-stitched soles, worn-thin leather hand guards on both hands; a length of broken heavy chain wound several times round her waist. She holds the loose end of the chain in one hand, a steady, watchful look.
private: At a mountain farmhouse door: a plain undyed linen shirt with the cuffs tied, a dark wool vest, dark trousers and the stitched boots, the braid hanging over one shoulder. She wipes a length of chain link by link with a cloth held in both hands. A quiet, tired look.
battle: Hauling a wall: the black leather jacket buckled tight, iron-ringed cuffs, a small clan gate-and-flame badge at the chest glowing like a coal, leather hand guards, the chain unwound from her waist with ember-lit lines etched along its links. She grips the heavy broken chain in both hands, a long length swinging low and ready to throw, a hard, steady look.
formal: At a gathering of the mountain clans: a black leather long coat with a stand collar and a row of small iron buttons, iron-ringed cuffs, a dark red wool sash, a dark red cloak hooked on one shoulder, her old obsidian horn crown polished, a small gate-and-flame badge in dark red thread at the chest. The short length of broken chain is still wound at her waist. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave, unflinching look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the red-gold eyes looking at the viewer steadily, both hands gripping a taut heavy chain close beside her face, the old marks across both palms showing. Cold grey dawn light from one side over a ridge of ash. Foreground blur: big iron chain links, drifting ash and a black iron nail. She wears the short black leather jacket with the iron-ringed cuffs.

name: 托芙·深井
src: 底卡新条目/活到今天的旧人.md:41
who: Tove Deepwell, a dwarf woman of the Deepwell line who keeps her post at the sealed mouth beneath the oldest forge city, listening to the rock with a brass cone; a legend whose name was fixed long ago, still looking about twenty-two after a thousand years: short, about 129 cm, slight and narrower than other dwarf women, always a little stooped, as if listening even when she stands straight. Silver-white hair cut at the ears and tied with a short piece of well rope. Big ice-blue eyes that shine in the dark and squint in bright light. A grey film of well-dust on her face and the backs of her hands that never washes off; even her eyebrows are grey with it. A clean, beardless face. A quiet, exact air; she always asks first whether the ground under your feet is solid.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young dwarf woman's face of about twenty-two, small but grown-up, NOT a child's: big ice-blue almond eyes, a little narrowed, with a thin tapering upper lash line; dust-grey brows; a small nose; a small, serious mouth; a clean, beardless face with a faint grey film of dust on the cheeks; no glasses and no lens. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 129 cm, small, slight and narrow for a dwarf, a strong back for carrying props.
palette: well-dust grey and silver white, ice blue, dark leather, flameless blue-white
casual: Her listener's gear: a short dark leather coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and thick leather patches at the knees and elbows, dark trousers and soft boots; at her belt a small lamp of cold, flameless blue-white light, a brass listening cone, a small hatchet for splitting props and a coil of well rope. She holds the brass listening cone in one hand, a quiet, attentive look.
private: Above ground for once: a loose grey wool tunic dress with long sleeves, dark leggings and soft boots, the well-rope tie in her hair. She polishes the glass shade of her flameless lamp with a cloth. A calm, faraway look.
battle: Bracing the deep stone: the leather coat buttoned, thick leather gloves, the flameless lamp and the listening cone at her belt, a bundle of wooden props on her back. She grips the prop-splitting hatchet in her right hand, a still, counting look.
battle_pose: 3) the listener's outfit: leaning forward a little with the knees bent and the feet planted wide, one gloved hand pressing the brass listening cone flat out in front of her, the other holding a wooden prop out ready to wedge it, the eyes narrowed and listening, a still, counting look; she carries no blade.
formal: At a gathering of the Deepwell line: a long dark grey wool dress with long sleeves and a stand collar buttoned to the throat, a clean leather belt with the listening cone, the hair freshly tied with new well rope, a small brass pin of a prop and a wedge at the chest. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue eyes glowing in darkness, the brass listening cone pressed to a stone wall beside her ear. Cold blue-white light from the flameless lamp below on one side. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust, the grain of a wooden prop, a coil of rope. She wears the patched short leather coat.

name: 朵薇·六钟
src: 底卡新条目/活到今天的旧人.md:58
who: Dove, a demon-kin of the white-bone folk from the city of bone bells, the name-keeper who writes every missing person's full name into the archive of the dead; a legend whose name was fixed long ago, still looking about twenty-five after nearly a thousand years: about 158 cm, slight, her back straight. Skin white almost to translucence. Ivory-white hair cut level with the chin; the fringe hides a small patch of bone on her left temple carved with her birth number (on the viewer's right when they face us). Pale violet eyes. On her right hand the bare bones of the forefinger and middle finger are stained black with ink (on the viewer's left when they face us). A grave, orderly, patient air; her folk never sleep.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of about twenty-five, thin and gentle, NOT old: pale violet almond eyes, steady; thin pale brows; a small straight nose; a small closed mouth. Skin white almost to translucence with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool lilac grey. A smooth, unlined face.
build: 158 cm, slight and thin, the back straight.
palette: ivory white and pale violet, register grey, ink black, a little lamplight gold
casual: Her archive clothes: a long grey coat of the tomb city's name-copiers with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and the cuffs tied tight against ink, over a white shirt and dark trousers; a leather satchel slung across her shoulder holding a ledger, a bottle of ink, a bone-shafted pen and a small knife for carving bone tags; soft-soled boots that make no sound. She holds the bone pen above an open ledger, a calm, attentive look.
private: Late in the quiet hours: the grey coat off, a soft grey knitted cardigan over a long dark dress, soft slippers. She holds a closed ledger against her chest with both hands. A peaceful look.
battle: Calling the roll of the missing in the dark: the long grey coat with a dark wool cloak over it, the satchel strapped tight. She holds an open ledger in one arm and raises the ink-blackened fingers of her right hand as she counts; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the roll-call outfit: steady and alert, the feet together, holding the open ledger in one arm and raising her right hand with the ink-blackened bone fingers as she counts names; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day of remembrance: a grey felt overcoat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat over a dark wool dress with a white linen collar, a leather ink-belt with small bone pens, the fringe neatly over the carved bone, the ledger under her arm. Tiny ink-black marks run along the felt edge. She stands very upright, the hands folded, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet eyes looking at the viewer over an open ledger, the bone pen poised in her ink-blackened fingers. Warm lamplight from one side in grey mist. Foreground blur: drifting mist, a drop of ink, the ruled edge of a blank page. She wears the long grey name-copier's coat.
art_extra: Her hair stays plain ivory white, not lavender or pink.

name: 坎黛丝·焰沙
src: 底卡新条目/活到今天的旧人.md:75
who: Candace Flamesand, a fire-horn demon-kin woman from the glassblowers' street of the Horned Flame City, a retired captain of the Obsidian deep expeditionary army who now blows glass; a legend whose name was fixed long ago, still looking just past thirty after centuries: tall, about 180 cm, broad-shouldered, thick-backed and long-legged. Skin with the red cast of fired clay, a glow of fire at the hollow of the throat. Two horns curving back from the temples, sheathed in mountain-copper horn sleeves pierced with small vents that glow red. Hair charcoal black at the roots and orange-red toward the ends like burning coal, in one thick braid to the waist. Pale cyan eyes like new glass. A faint scar across the left brow bone (on the viewer's right when they face us). Her right arm, from the shoulder down, is an electro-mechanical prosthetic of black obsidian steel, the second one fitted. A loud, quick-tempered, protective air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strong woman's face of just past thirty: medium almond eyes of pale cyan, clear as glass; strong dark brows; a faint pale scar across the left brow bone (on the viewer's right when she faces us); a wide mouth quick to grin. Skin with a warm red-clay tint and very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm red-brown, a faint orange glow at the hollow of the throat.
build: 180 cm, tall and powerful: broad shoulders, a thick back, long legs; the right shoulder sits a little lower than the left.
palette: obsidian black and deep red, red clay, ember orange, pale cyan glass, mountain copper
casual: Her glass-street clothes: a thick leather glassblower's apron over a dark red linen shirt with the left sleeve rolled up and a stand collar open at the throat, wide dark trousers and heavy boots; the mountain-copper horn sleeves with only two vents open; the black steel right arm bare to the shoulder. She holds a small red-tinted glass cup in the steel hand, a loud, cocky grin.
private: On a day off: a loose dark red linen shirt with the left sleeve rolled up, the black steel right arm bare, wide dark trousers and soft boots, the braid over one shoulder, only two vents open in her horn sleeves. She holds a blown glass bowl in the steel hand. A relaxed, warm look.
battle: Charging at a closing wall: her old black-and-red captain's plate buckled tight, a dark red padded coat under it, every vent in her horn sleeves thrown open and glowing. A broad-bladed short sword in her left hand, the black steel right arm braced forward with the palm open, as if holding up a falling wall, the head lowered; a fierce grin.
formal: On Ceasefire Day, reading three names: a black dress coat of the old expeditionary army with dark red facings, a stand collar buttoned to the throat and a bronze breast plate embossed with a well mark, a half-cape on one shoulder, a sash, the horn sleeves polished with their vents glowing a dull red, a black glove on the steel hand. She stands upright with the hands at her sides, a grave, slow look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes laughing at the viewer, the copper horn sleeves with every vent glowing red, the black steel hand raised near her face. Hot ember-orange light from one side, as from a glass kiln. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, a red-tinted glass shard, a row of battered wooden posts. She wears a leather glassblower's apron over the dark red shirt.

name: 肯特·墨鳞
src: 底卡新条目/活到今天的旧人.md:92
who: Kent Inkscale, a dragonborn of the ink-scale line who keeps the map room of the great shaft's guild hall and calls out names before every descent; a legend whose name was fixed long ago, looking about thirty-five and unchanged for two centuries: about 214 cm, tall and broad, standing like a door. His right arm hangs half-useless and cannot be raised (on the viewer's left when they face us). Ink-black scales with a blue sheen cover his neck, cheeks, the backs of his hands and his forearms, like wet slate after rain. A long scar without scales runs white from his left brow bone down to the jaw (on the viewer's right when they face us). Short steel-blue hair with no white. Copper-green slit-pupilled eyes. A slow, heavy, sparing air: he says half a sentence and waits to see whether you understood. Where there are no scales his skin is fair with a cool grey tint, NOT brown and NOT tanned.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dragonborn man's face of about thirty-five, strong and heavy-browed, NOT old: copper-green eyes with narrow vertical slit pupils; ink-black scales with a blue sheen over the cheeks and down the neck; a long pale scar without scales from the left brow bone to the jaw (on the viewer's right when he faces us); a firm, closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft cool slate tone.
build: 214 cm, tall, broad and thick; the right arm hangs lower and slack.
palette: ink black with a blue sheen, steel blue, copper green, old iron, a little bone white
casual: His map-room clothes: a long dark slate coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and the right sleeve hanging loose, a leather vest, dark trousers and heavy boots; on his left arm a tower shield wider than half his body, its outer face polished bright and its inner face carved all over with small rows of names, the inner face turned toward himself; a folded old map tucked inside his coat. A heavy, steady look.
private: In the map room at night: a long-sleeved dark wool shirt with the right sleeve loose, a leather vest, dark trousers and soft boots, the shield leaned aside. He holds an old map, folded and worn through at the creases, open in his left hand. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Standing a shield wall: the old black scale armour inlaid with thin lines of dull red ember-runes, the right arm held close against the body, the great tower shield braced forward on his left arm with the inner face carved with rows of names and a ring of small stone seals along the rim, the mouth open in a call. A deep, unmoving look.
battle_pose: 3) the shield-wall outfit: braced and heavy, the feet planted wide, the great tower shield held forward on his left arm, the useless right arm hanging close against the body, the mouth open in a call; he carries no other weapon.
formal: At the council table of the guild: the black scale mantle of an old assault captain worn over a long dark slate surcoat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and belted with a wide leather strap, a short grey mantle over one shoulder, small ink-black scales along the forearms catching a dull ember light. He stands very upright, the left hand resting on the rim of the great shield set on its edge beside him, the right arm hanging, a grave, patient look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the copper-green slit eyes looking down at the viewer, the inner face of the tower shield rising beside him, carved with rows of small marks. Cold white fog light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting white mist, the edge of a black scale and a folded old map. He wears the long dark slate coat.
